Each endpoint exterior makes a cell section nonconstant with probability 2 epsilon(1-epsilon), and each cell TV is 1-2 epsilon. At epsilon=1/100 the false bound is 14553/250000 and the difference is 249851/250000. The valid inequality with actual hybrid laws is not refuted.

To use it as a square-bond/triangular-site bridge, one must construct faithful full connectivity-state laws on a common skeleton and prove their summed weighted error vanishes uniformly over all intermediate laws, including boundary cells.
